Runs a baseline test on PHP 5.6 and the suite passes there
composer.json require.php is >=8.5 and phpunit/phpunit is ^13
OldStyle has a __construct method and declares $upper (no dynamic property)
No each(), create_function(), $name{0} or "${name}" remain in src/
OldStyle::label takes ?array $options = null

verify.sh exits 0 with fail-on-deprecation/warning/notice
